root.description: The scribe data directory, an absolute path (the CLI's ~/.scribe). The sandbox grants access to it alone. The default, /var/tmp, means unset: every tool answers not_configured until it is set.

transcripts.description: Claude Code's projects directory, an absolute path (~/.claude/projects, or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects). scribe.session-pass reads the transcripts of sessions switched on with /scribe on there; until it is set (the default is empty), it answers not_configured.

codex_home.description: Optional absolute Codex state directory (~/.codex or CODEX_HOME) for active/archive transcript discovery and existing auth. Empty disables Codex discovery; Claude configuration remains valid. Model-backed Orbit execution also needs the Codex-enabled package and its narrow runtime write settings; read access alone is insufficient. Scribe never copies credentials.

group_summary_crew.description: Orbit crew used to summarize a group.

profile_refresh_crew.description: Orbit crew used to rebuild the memory profile.

session_distill_crew.description: Orbit crew for session window distillation. Defaults to haiku.

session_header_crew.description: Orbit crew for session header compression. Defaults to haiku.
